intro: The smirk emoji 😏 carries two meanings at once — smug, self-satisfied confidence and a flirty, suggestive 'I know something you don't.' This page gathers the whole smug range: the calm 😌 relieved face, the deadpan 🙂 slightly smiling face, the 😼 wry-smiling cat, and sly winks like 😉 and 😜 for a playful reaction. When an emoji won't carry the exact vibe, classic smug kaomoji like (¬‿¬) and ( ͡~ ͜ʖ ͡°) paste anywhere plain text works. The 😎 sunglasses face gets a light nod here — it has its own full page — while this one stays focused on the smirk itself. Grab a single face, or copy a ready-made combo set for flirty replies, confident flexes, and knowing reactions.
